what: twelve re-descriptions of a locked garment, and whether a person would call each one the same garment
why: the lock refuses a retyped block. this corpus measures how often retyping would have been harmless to a human, which is the size of the gap the lock closes. a rewrite a person accepts is still a rewrite a renderer treats as a new garment, because nothing in the text tells it which words were load bearing.
source: hand written against the invent spec. the adaptionlabs invent run (dataset 26572b6e-dbcc-415a-83dc-12d8df2ac01f, 12 rows, 2 credits estimated) never produced downloadable rows inside the window, so the rows were authored here rather than waiting on it.
locked:
outer: oatmeal heavy brushed wool wool overcoat
fit: relaxed, below the knee
details: double breasted; horn buttons; patch pockets
avoid: belted waist; synthetic sheen; logos
